verdict.line: You lose if you trade into her stacked Ionian Fervor or let her land a free Flawless Duet before level 6; you win by surviving the early skirmishes and converting Ornn's level-6 Call of the Forge God plus tank itemization into forced fights.

brief.thesis: Irelia wins the lane and the 1-for-1 duel on her own — Bladesurge gives her a free gap-closer every 10 to 6 seconds and her stacking Ionian Fervor passive turns extended trades in her favor before Ornn has the tools to answer. Ornn's real advantage is structural, not a lane-phase one: Bellows Breath's Brittle and a terrain-charged Searing Charge knockup turn skirmishes into forced exchanges once his tank core and R are online. The 52.1% head-to-head winrate over 944 games reflects a lane that's typically lost early and clawed back from level 6 onward with the right build.

theirWindow.when: Irelia sitting at max Fervor stacks
theirWindow.what: She'll commit with E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, then chain Q (Bladesurge) into stacked, faster autos. Searing Charge's 450 range can't contest her 850-range E, so disengage toward minions or your tower instead.

yourWindow.when: Right after her E (Flawless Duet) whiffs
yourWindow.what: Her only stun is down for 16 to 10 seconds by rank, and Bladesurge won't refresh its cooldown without a Mark or a kill. Step in with Q (Volcanic Rupture) to slow, follow with W (Bellows Breath) for Brittle, then charge E (Searing Charge) into terrain for the knockup.

start.why: 49.8% winrate over 504 games. The regen and autoattack block blunt Irelia's early Bladesurge pokes and let you hold CS without burning summoners.

boots.why: 52.2% winrate over 972 games (90.3% pick rate). Flat physical damage reduction directly counters her auto-attack-heavy, Fervor-stacked trade pattern.

core.why: Cuts into the healing Irelia gets from Bladesurge, undercutting her sustain in extended trades.
Passive damage punishes her for staying in melee range during Fervor-stacked exchanges.
Grievous Wounds shuts down the Bladesurge heal entirely once completed; this path hits 56.4% winrate over 55 games, the highest sampled build.
Stacking resistances and the damage-reduction active keep Ornn alive through her burst windows in prolonged fights.

situational.when: their comp adds heavy magic damage alongside irelia
she's stacking attack speed and auto-resetting off fervor
you need more sustain through extended skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustained HP growth and free poke damage keep Ornn healthy through a lane phase he's statistically losing, without needing to commit to risky trades.

summoners.why: Flash + Teleport is run in 73.3% of games at 50.7% winrate and lets Ornn freeze safely and reset for plates in a lane he's behind in. Flash + Ignite measures higher at 55.3% over a smaller sample if you want to pressure early kill windows instead.

playing.title: Track her Fervor stack count
playing.detail: Irelia's Ionian Fervor stacks attack speed on spell hits; once she's near max stacks she'll look to commit, so disengage rather than trade autos back.

playing.title: Punish a missed Flawless Duet
playing.detail: Her E stun sits on a 16 to 10 second cooldown by rank. If it whiffs, step in with Q to slow and W for Brittle before she can reset with Bladesurge.

playing.title: Respect Bladesurge resets
playing.detail: Q refreshes its cooldown if the target is Marked or dies to it, so don't fight at low HP once she's landed an E Mark on you.

playing.title: Line up E into terrain
playing.detail: Searing Charge only knocks up and shockwaves if Ornn collides with terrain mid-charge, so aim it at lane walls instead of open space for the extra damage and crowd control.

playing.title: Freeze and farm levels 3-5
playing.detail: Her full combo plus stacking Fervor wins extended trades before Ornn hits 6. Hold the wave near your tower and only poke with Q when she overextends.

playing.title: Force fights after level 6
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God's knockup and Brittle let Ornn dictate engages that Irelia can't out-trade once Bramble Vest and Sunfire Aegis are online.

playing.title: Pivot to Frozen Heart vs on-hit
playing.detail: If her build leans into attack speed and on-hit effects, Frozen Heart's aura slow directly cuts the extra attack speed Fervor gives her.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and the 52.1% head-to-head winrate over 944 games are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch; the reasoning about stack timing, cooldown windows, and trade patterns is my own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid fighting Irelia when she has her (P) stacks up. Irelia will try to fight with (E) when she has full stacks on, so avoid it with either [W] or [E]. Try to hit and run often when fighting Irelia.
